deadline.evidence: The last date for receiving applications is March 5, 2026.

citizenship.evidence: Students pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree at a prominent institution in India. ‖ I am a native of India, presently studying abroad. Can I apply for SRIP? You are welcome to apply.

career_stage.evidence: Students in first, second and third year of UG studies are encouraged to apply. Students in their first year of PG studies can also apply.

institution.evidence: Students pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree at a prominent institution in India.

value: Applicants are required to work with an IITGN faculty.
Applicants will be required to make a presentation to the institute and submit a report at the end of the tenure.
other_requirements.evidence: Applicants are required to work with an IITGN faculty. ‖ Applicants will be required to make a presentation to the institute and submit a report at the end of the tenure.

other_documents.evidence: The student will be required to submit a research proposal one week after arriving at IITGN

duration.evidence: A minimum commitment of 8 weeks is mandatory for SRIP.

mode.evidence: In the present scenario, SRIP 2026 will be conducted in the offline mode.

location.evidence: In-person/offline mode: In this mode, the students are expected to work on the project in-person and interact with the faculty mentor on a regular basis while staying on campus.

stipend.evidence: Weekly SRIP stipend of INR 2000/- for minimum 8 weeks duration of internship at IITGN, is provided to most of the interns.

housing.value: Hostel accommodation provided for a fee of INR 175 per day
housing.evidence: Can I get Hostel accommodation during internship? Yes. The current Hostel accommodation charges are INR 175/- per day. All summer interns must pay the hostel charges.

extraction_notes: The programme is for 2026. The website states results have been published, implying the cycle is complete.
The deadline is explicitly stated as March 5, 2026.
Eligibility is described as students at prominent institutions in India, but the FAQ clarifies that Indian natives studying abroad are also welcome to apply.
